key_insight: Scal3R introduces a scalable test-time training strategy that adapts feed-forward 3D reconstruction models on-the-fly for long video sequences, using memory-efficient streaming updates and global-context aggregation to improve accuracy and temporal consistency.
problem_solved: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models lose accuracy and produce inconsistent geometry over long video sequences due to limited memory and poor access to global contextual cues; Scal3R enables continual, scalable adaptation at test time to address these issues.
method: Memory-efficient test-time training: perform lightweight online adaptation on incoming frames rather than full offline retraining, keeping per-frame memory and compute low.
Global-context aggregation: maintain a compact scene memory or hierarchical summary to provide long-range context for consistency across distant frames.
Consistency-driven losses: apply temporal and geometric consistency constraints during adaptation to reduce drift and improve reconstruction fidelity over long sequences.
impact: Enables reliable large-scale 3D reconstruction from long videos without expensive offline retraining or large memory footprints—useful for mapping, AR/VR, and mobile robotics where models must adapt to long, continuous streams in real environments.
